content: Dual-write problem: writing to Postgres and Kafka as two independent operations risks partial failure/inconsistency. Transactional outbox pattern solves this -- write domain change + outbox row in one DB transaction, relay (polling or Debezium CDC) publishes to Kafka async, guaranteeing event emitted iff DB commit succeeded. Downstream consumers must be idempotent since outbox gives at-least-once delivery.
